name: time-field
title: Time field
description: A typed time in the locale's clock, with minute steps and an optional time zone.

builtIn: Required fields show "Fill in this field."; a partly typed date says what is missing.

TimeField.name: label
TimeField.description: Always given; the label sits above the field and names its segments.

TimeField.name: errorMessage
TimeField.description: What happened and what to do; shown when the field is invalid.

TimeField.name: requiredValidation
TimeField.description:
Who says an empty required field is missing: `field` (default) or `app`. With `app` a DS
Form's `onSubmit` runs with the field empty, and the app's own error must clear on change. See
{@link RequiredValidation} for the whole contract.

TimeField.name: isOptional
TimeField.description: Shows "(optional)" when most of the form is required.

TimeField.name: isInvalid
TimeField.description: Marks the field invalid from outside (a server error); `errorMessage` says why.

TimeField.name: id
TimeField.description:
The id of the field's first typed segment (day, or the locale's first part), the element that takes focus
: `document.getElementById(id).focus()` puts the user in the field, as a focus-on-error does. The
field's group gets an id of its own. Left out, the DOM is as before.

TimeField.name: name
TimeField.description: The form field name; the value is submitted as an ISO string.

TimeField.name: value
TimeField.description:
A time, or a zoned date-time when a location's zone travels with it.

While the user leaves a time typed in part ("10:––"), the field reports `onChange(null)` and keeps the typed parts
on screen, so setting `null` changes nothing: the value already is null. To clear the field (an app's own "Temizle"
or form reset), give it a new `key` along with the value: React remounts it empty, or at the value given
.

TimeField.name: hourCycle
TimeField.description: 24-hour in tr and me, 12-hour in en-US; from the locale unless set.

TimeField.name: minuteStep
TimeField.description: Arrow keys step the minutes by this much (15 or 30).

TimeField.name: timeZone
TimeField.description: The location's zone (IANA, "Europe/Lisbon"). Named after the time when it differs from the user's.

TimeField.name: validate
TimeField.type: (value: TimeValue | null) => string | true | string[] | null | undefined
